messages:
Rina (People Ops): Heads-up: new compliance lane this quarter — safety & privacy refresher + evidence handoff. Please complete the 15-min refresher and drop evidence links by next Wed EOD. Course: https://lms.redwoodinference.com/refresher-2026 :spiral_calendar:

Rina (People Ops): Evidence can be a cert, LMS screenshot, or a short note + link to Confluence/Drive where artifacts live. If youre owning SOC2/ISO entries, add the control IDs youre covering.

Theo (Security): Note for engineers: for any service that processes customer data, include an access-review snapshot and the most recent config export. Were mapping these to CC-04 and CC-07 controls.

Omar (Eng): Quick question 1: I pushed infra logs to /evidence/eng/infra-2026 but dont see a cert. Is the log bundle sufficient?

Theo (Security): Yep, log bundle with timestamps + redactions is fine. Ill verify formats. If possible, include a short readme.txt describing what each file is.

Priya (Design): Do contractors need to fill this too? I have two contractors on content who touch PII in a limited way.
